title: The Altar of Scars
text: An altar of pale stone, crossed with old cuts like a butcher's block. Carved above it, in a hand that shook: it asks for a scar. The one who already carries the deepest, the carving promises, will be offered something back.

options.label: The one with an old wound lays it on the stone.

outcomes.text: The wound closes, and leaves a pale mark of favor where it was.
The altar takes a little more than the scar, and gives back something hard-won.

options.label: The unblooded gives it a first scar.

outcomes.text: A cut across the palm, deep and clean. They are not unblooded now, and they will not forget it.

options.label: Healer's hands bless the altar instead of bleeding on it.

outcomes.text: The altar falls quiet, almost sulking, and the party's cuts begin to close.
